chapter_title: For one afflicted with doubt in his faith
chapter_title_arabic: دعاء من أصابه شك في الإيمان

duas.dua_text_english: I seek refuge in Allah. (Then you should desist from doing what you are in doubt about.)
duas.dua_text_arabic:
يَسْتَعِيذُ بِاللَّهِ.
يَنْتَهِي عَمَّا شك فِيهِ.

duas.dua_text_english: I believe in Allah and His Messengers.
He is the First and the Last, the Most High and the Most Near. And He is the Knower of all things. (Recite the Ayat in Arabic)
duas.dua_text_transliteration: Huwa 'l-Awwalu wa 'l-Ākhir, waẓ-Ẓāhiru wal-Bāṭin, wa huwa bikulli shay'in 'Alīm
duas.dua_text_arabic: هُوَ الأوَّلُ، وَالآخِـرُ، وَالظّـاهِـرُ، وَالْبـاطِـنُ، وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَيءٍ عَلـيم
duas.reference: Al-Hadid 57:3, Abu Dawud 4/329. Al-Albani graded it good in Sahih Abu Dawud 3/962
